story.region: A suburban house in Ohio, 3:07 AM
story.title: Why Does the Tapping Start at 3:07?

narrator.persona: a homeowner two weeks after a break-in

sentences.text: Never ignore the tapping under the floorboards at 3:07.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Since the investigator found the murder weapon downstairs, my house has never felt quiet.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I pushed open the cellar door to see the root-vines crawling across the concrete.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It was a giant rust-colored flower on a thick stem, its face made of five golden eyes and a ring-toothed mouth holding the exact knife from the crime scene.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It cast no shadow until it slowly absorbed the dim glow of my flashlight into its shifting petals.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you ignore the tapping under the floorboards at 3:07?
sentences.speaker: narrator
